objectives: Falar seu nome e de onde você é
Usar o verbo "to be" no presente
lessons.starter: Hi! Let's practice. Tell me your name and where you're from.

objectives: Descrever sua rotina com presente simples
lessons.starter: Let's talk about your daily routine. What time do you wake up?

objectives: Contar eventos passados com passado simples
lessons.starter: What did you do last weekend?

objectives: Falar sobre planos futuros com "going to"
lessons.starter: Tell me about a trip you're planning. Where are you going to go?
What's your opinion about working from home? Why?
If you had an extra week of vacation, what would you do?
Some people say remote work hurts teamwork. Do you agree or disagree? Convince me.

lessons.topic: Phrasal verbs no dia a dia
objectives: Usar phrasal verbs em contexto real
lessons.starter: Tell me about a problem you had to figure out recently.

objectives: Adaptar o tom da fala para contextos formais e informais
lessons.starter: Pretend you're asking your boss for a day off, then ask a close friend the same thing. Show me both.

vocabulary: hit the nail on the head
lessons.starter: Tell me about something that was a piece of cake for you, and something that gave you a hard time.
